bead.title: Derive stable server instance identity
bead.description: Add normalized server-instance identity for provider endpoints. Identity should prefer an explicit config field when present and otherwise derive from the endpoint host/port. This identity is diagnostic, appears in route evidence, and is the target of sticky affinity.
bead.acceptance:
1. Provider endpoints can expose a configured server_instance value.
2. When unset, server_instance is derived deterministically from base_url host/port after /v1 root normalization.
3. ModelInfo, Candidate, RouteDecision, RouteStatus, and session routing evidence include server_instance.
4. Tests cover grendel, vidar, and sindri-style base URLs plus explicit override.
5. go test ./internal/config ./internal/routing ./cmd/fiz -run "ServerInstance|EndpointIdentity|RouteStatus" passes.
